problem: Autonomy can commit an assistant final and return its run to ready in the same transaction. A completed-run-only exporter misses that accepted reply.

implementation.authority: Existing authenticated origin, current group and run authority, and fresh transport access checks retained
implementation.delegation: Child results remain parent-collected; child activity can settle without attempting separate channel delivery
implementation.scheduled_output: Scheduled occurrences retain their independently checked originating audience
implementation.scope: Activity scheduler publishes accepted finals without waiting for continuing inference to end
